title: Export (Sidiary-Format) - Type mismatch
symptom: Because of Line Feed in Remark, the exported csv isn't usable as Sidiary import file. It gives a type mismatch.
cause: Line feed in the remark field of the exported CSV causes a type mismatch when importing into Sidiary.
fix: Implement escaped linefeed (very special chars ||) for the export. A pull request was made and tested with the last nightly.
